title: Witch Hat Atelier Previews Season Finale
content: Witch Hat Atelier anime released a preview video of the finale (episode 13) of the series. It is slated to release on June 22 and can be streamed on Netflix and Crunchyroll. Also check out: Eve Releases Witch Hat Atelier Opening Song Special Music Video Ayumu Watanabe is directing the anime at studio BUG FILMS.
author: Anime Corner

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend Unveils Special Visual
content: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend movie unveiled a special visual on Tuesday, featuring Shoko Makinohara. The movie is slated to release on October 16 in Japanese theaters. The series also revealed a main trailer recently. CloverWorks returns to animate the movie with Souichi Masui as director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Dandadan Returns With an Official New Release Ahead of Season 3
content: The acclaimed Shonen Jump+ manga, Dandadan , by Yukinobu Tatsu, was released five years ago on April 6th, 2021. The series has come a long way since then and reached new heights of popularity thanks to the incredible adaptation by Science SARU.
author: ComicBook

title: Solo Leveling Studio’s Upcoming Anime Unveils Release Date With a New Look
content: Solo Leveling premiered its highly anticipated Season 2 last year as part of the Winter 2025 lineup and adapted the best arc of the story. The latest season was a rollercoaster of emotions as Jinwoo finally managed to wake his mother up from her eternal slumber.
author: ComicBook

title: The Apothecary Diaries Returns With a Brand New Release Ahead of Anime Sequel
content: Whether it’s the palace drama or the mysteries, fans can experience it all in the first simulation game based on the beloved anime, The Apothecary Diaries . The anime concluded its second season in July 2025 before announcing a Season 3 and an upcoming feature film.
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Studio Teases Exciting New Project
content: After an exciting run in Winter this year, Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 reached its conclusion with a major cliffhanger, leaving several questions unanswered. The story continues after the intense Shibuya Incident Arc, following the aftermath of the major battle that took place during Halloween.
author: ComicBook

title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System Reveals New PV, US-Exclusive Visual, and ReoNa Ending Theme
content: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System has revealed a new U.S.-exclusive key visual and its second main PV trailer ahead of the anime’s July 2 premiere. The series will stream on Crunchyroll and run for two consecutive cours .
author: Anime Corner

title: 1st U.S. Store for Ghibli Goods Opens as Pop-Up in Southern California
content: Viz announced on Monday that Donguri Republic, the store chain in Japan which carries official merchandise from Studio Ghibli and other studios, is opening its first pop-up store in the United States. The store will open at the Del Amo Fashion Center in Torrance, California and will run from June 23 to December 31.
author: ANN

title: HIDIVE Streams Raunchy Rom-Com Anime I'm Dating a Dark Summoner This October
content: HIDIVE announced that it will exclusively stream the I’m Dating a Dark Summoner anime this October, adapting the manga series created by Shaoh and published by KADOKAWA. WWWave is handling production; the series will be produced under WWWave’s Deregula animation label.
author: Anime Corner
